newsitem.title: CHINA: Qingdao Haier to delay B share issue.
newsitem.headline: Qingdao Haier to delay B share issue.

text.p: Qingdao Haier Refrigerator Co will delay its B share issue due to objections from its biggest shareholder, Haier Group Co, a company spokesman said on Monday.

Qingdao Haier had planned to issue 110 million B shares in the first half of 1997 and had obtained permission from the China Securites Regulatory Commission, the spokesman said, adding that the firm had amended the issue to 200 million.
"If we issue 200 million B shares, Haier Group will lose its controlling shareholder position," he said. "So we are working on a new plan to ensure the group's controlling position."
"If the new plan goes smoothly, we will issue B shares later this year, otherwise the issue will be postponed to next near." he said.
Qingdao Haier has a total of 187.874 million shares outstanding, of which Haier Group owns 54 percent.
The company has proposed a three-for-10 rights issue on its domestic A shares at a price of six yuan per share to meet its current financing needs, the company's 1996 annual report said.
The company reported a net profit of 178.24 million yuan in 1996, 52 percent up the 1995 profit of 117.31 million yuan.
